name: Neyo
summary:
🏡 Neyo – Explore Prefabricated Homes

With Neyo, architecture becomes a walkable experience before construction begins. Step inside fully furnished prefab houses from top German manufacturers – realistic, intuitive, immersive.

🚶‍♂️ What to Expect:
> Virtual walkthroughs of real 3D floorplans
> Highly realistic interiors with premium design
> Free navigation through every room
> Switch between house models
> Compare layouts, styles, and finishes

🎯 Our Mission:
To make building visualization and virtual
